query_text: Which section in IPC corresponds to Section 100 of BNS?
ground_truth_answer: BNS Section 100 defines culpable homicide, corresponding to IPC Section 299.

query_text: Where is unlawful assembly defined in BNS?
ground_truth_answer: Unlawful assembly is defined under Section 189 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 141).

query_text: What is the exact equivalent section of IPC Section 124A (Sedition) in BNS 2023?
ground_truth_answer: IPC Section 124A (Sedition) was repealed without direct equivalent; BNS Section 152 addresses subversive acts.

query_text: What is the new section for murder under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023?
ground_truth_answer: Under BNS 2023, murder punishment is Section 103 (formerly IPC 302).

query_text: What section covers using a forged document as genuine?
ground_truth_answer: Using as genuine a forged document is under Section 340 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 471).

query_text: What section governs harbouring an offender in BNS?
ground_truth_answer: Harbouring an offender is governed by Section 249 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 212).

query_text: What is the section for hurt under BNS 2023?
ground_truth_answer: Hurt is defined under Section 114 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 319).

query_text: What section penalizes rioting in BNS?
ground_truth_answer: Rioting is penalized under Section 191 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 146/147).

query_text: What section governs rash driving on a public way?
ground_truth_answer: Rash driving on a public way is penalized under Section 281 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 279).

query_text: What is the BNS provision for counterfeiting currency notes?
ground_truth_answer: Counterfeiting currency notes or bank notes is covered under Section 178 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC 489A).

query_text: Where is trafficking of persons defined in BNS 2023?
ground_truth_answer: Trafficking of persons is under Section 143 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 370).

query_text: What section penalizes robbery in BNS 2023?
ground_truth_answer: Robbery is penalized under Section 309 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC Section 390/392).

query_text: What section covers seditious libel / acts endangering sovereignty in BNS?
ground_truth_answer: Acts endangering sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India are under Section 152 of BNS 2023.

query_text: Is adultery under IPC 497 punishable under the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita?
ground_truth_answer: No, adultery under IPC Section 497 was struck down in Joseph Shine and omitted entirely from BNS 2023.

query_text: Where is dowry death covered in BNS 2023?
ground_truth_answer: Dowry death is governed by Section 80 of BNS 2023 (formerly IPC 304B).
